paragraphs: Purpose of the Committee:The SC/ST Committee is constituted in accordance with the guidelines of the University Grants Commission (UGC) and/or AICTE to ensure the welfare, equal opportunity, and protection of rights for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe students, faculty, and staff within the institution. Objectives:1. To prevent caste-based discrimination in any form.2. To provide a platform for SC/ST members to raise grievances.3. To monitor the implementation of reservation policies.4. To promote equality, inclusion, and dignity on campus.5. To sensitize the campus community on issues related to caste equity.
